caps.what: direct costs per year (modular, in multiples of $25,000)

match.quote: This NOFO does not require cost sharing as defined in the NIH Grants Policy Statement Section 1.2 Definition of Terms .

award.quote: Application budgets are limited to $125,000 in direct costs per year.

sections.name: Professional Development Plan
sections.component: SF424(R&R) Other Project Information: Other Attachments
sections.quote: Applicants must include an attachment titled "Professional Development Plan" (PDP) that describes an individualized plan to garner resources, activities, collaborations, and/or didactic or practical experiences

sections.name: Research Strategy
sections.quote: Research Strategy: In accordance with the goals of the GEMSSTAR program, the Research Strategy should emphasize how the candidate's proposed research will advance the understanding of aging- or geriatrics-related science

sections.name: Resource Sharing Plan
sections.quote: Resource Sharing Plan : Individuals are required to comply with the instructions for the Resource Sharing Plans as provided in the How to Apply - Application Guide .

sections.name: Data Management and Sharing Plan
sections.conditional: Research that will generate scientific data
sections.quote: A Data Management and Sharing Plan (DMS Plan) is required for any NIH-funded or conducted research that will generate scientific data.

sections.name: Recruitment and Retention Plan
sections.component: Study Record: PHS Human Subjects and Clinical Trials Information, Section 2.5
sections.quote: The recruitment and retention plan must: Describe potential barriers to participation and plans to minimize these barriers. Describe a plan to leverage existing relationships with and/or conduct outreach to a broad range of community groups.

criteria.name: Factor 1. Importance of the Research (Significance and Innovation)
criteria.quote: Factor 1. Importance of the Research (Significance and Innovation) Significance Evaluate the importance of the proposed research in the context of current scientific challenges and opportunities

criteria.name: Factor 2. Rigor and Feasibility (Approach)
criteria.quote: Factor 2. Rigor and Feasibility (Approach) Approach Evaluate the scientific quality of the proposed work.

criteria.name: Factor 3. Expertise and Resources (Investigator(s) and Environment)
criteria.quote: Factor 3. Expertise and Resources (Investigator(s) and Environment) Investigator(s) Evaluate whether the investigator(s) have demonstrated background, training, and expertise

criteria.name: Protections for Human Subjects
criteria.quote: For research that involves human subjects but does not involve one of the categories of research that are exempt under 45 CFR Part 46, evaluate the justification for involvement of human subjects

criteria.name: Vertebrate Animals
criteria.quote: When the proposed research includes Vertebrate Animals, evaluate the involvement of live vertebrate animals according to the following criteria

criteria.name: Biohazards
criteria.quote: When the proposed research includes Biohazards, evaluate whether specific materials or procedures that will be used are significantly hazardous to research personnel and/or the environment

criteria.name: Resubmissions
criteria.quote: Resubmissions As applicable, evaluate the full application as now presented.

criteria.name: Renewals
criteria.quote: Renewals As applicable, evaluate the progress made in the last funding period.

criteria.name: Revisions
criteria.quote: Revisions As applicable, evaluate the appropriateness of the proposed expansion of the scope of the project.

criteria.name: Professional Development Plan
criteria.quote: Professional Development Plan Evaluate the extent to which the Professional Development Plan promotes the candidate's knowledge and skills in geriatrics- or aging-related research.

criteria.name: Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources
criteria.quote: For projects involving key biological and/or chemical resources, evaluate the brief plans proposed for identifying and ensuring the validity of those resources.

criteria.name: Budget and Period of Support
criteria.quote: Evaluate whether the budget and the requested period of support are fully justified and reasonable in relation to the proposed research.

other: Follow all page limits in the How to Apply Application Guide and Table of Page Limits
Only limited Appendix materials allowed: no publications or other material except blank questionnaires or blank surveys
DMS Plan must use the NIH DMS Plan Format Page; no extra narrative where it asks Yes or No
format.quote: No publications or other material, with the exception of blank questionnaires or blank surveys, may be included in the Appendix.

eligibility.item: Eligible organizations: higher education institutions, nonprofits, for-profits (incl. small businesses), state/county/city/township/special district governments, tribal governments, eligible federal agencies, U.S. territories, independent school districts, public/Indian housing authorities, tribal organizations, faith- or community-based organizations, regional organizations
eligibility.quote: Higher Education Institutions - Includes all types Public/State Controlled Institutions of Higher Education Private Institutions of Higher Education

eligibility.item: Non-domestic (non-U.S.) entities are not eligible
eligibility.quote: Non-domestic (non-U.S.) Entities (Foreign Organizations) are not eligible to apply.

eligibility.item: Non-domestic components of U.S. organizations are not eligible
eligibility.quote: Non-domestic (non-U.S.) components of U.S. Organizations are not eligible to apply.

eligibility.item: Foreign components, as defined in the NIH Grants Policy Statement, are allowed
eligibility.quote: Foreign components, as defined in the NIH Grants Policy Statement , are allowed.

eligibility.item: Applications involving foreign subawards/subcontracts are noncompliant and will not be funded
eligibility.quote: Applications involving foreign subawards/subcontracts submitted in response to this NOFO will be deemed noncompliant and will not be considered for funding.

eligibility.item: All organizational registrations must be completed before submission (allow 6 weeks or more)
eligibility.quote: All registrations must be completed prior to the application being submitted. Registration can take 6 weeks or more

eligibility.item: Maintain an active SAM registration, renewed at least annually
eligibility.quote: System for Award Management (SAM) – Applicants must complete and maintain an active registration, which requires renewal at least annually .

eligibility.item: Use the same UEI for all registrations and on the application
eligibility.quote: The same UEI must be used for all registrations, as well as on the grant application.

eligibility.item: Organization must register in eRA Commons with at least one Signing Official and one PD/PI account
eligibility.quote: eRA Commons requires organizations to identify at least one Signing Official (SO) and at least one Program Director/Principal Investigator (PD/PI) account in order to submit an application.

eligibility.item: Organization must complete Grants.gov registration (requires active SAM registration)
eligibility.quote: Grants.gov – Applicants must have an active SAM registration in order to complete the Grants.gov registration.

eligibility.item: PD/PI must have an eRA Commons account affiliated with the applicant organization
eligibility.quote: All PD(s)/PI(s) must have an eRA Commons account. PD(s)/PI(s) should work with their organizational officials to either create a new account or to affiliate their existing account

eligibility.item: PD/PI eRA Commons profile must be linked to a valid ORCID ID
eligibility.quote: All PD(s)/PI(s) must be registered with ORCID . The personal profile associated with the PD(s)/PI(s) eRA Commons account must be linked to a valid ORCID ID.

eligibility.item: PD/PI must enter their eRA Commons ID in the Credential field of the Senior/Key Person Profile form
eligibility.quote: All PD(s)/PI(s) must include their eRA Commons ID in the Credential field of the Senior/Key Person Profile form .

eligibility.item: Candidate must hold a clinical doctoral degree (e.g., MD, DO, DDS, DMD, PharmD, DNP, DPT, DVM); research doctorates such as the PhD are generally ineligible
eligibility.quote: Candidates for this award must have a clinical doctoral degree. Such degrees include, but are not limited to, the MD, DO, DDS, DMD, OD, DC, PharmD

eligibility.item: Not open to candidates already funded as PI on an NIH aging-related career development (excluding K38 and K99) or research award; institutional awards (KL2, R25, NIA P30 REC) do not disqualify
eligibility.quote: This award is not intended for candidates who have already received funding as a principal investigator on an NIH aging-related career development (excluding K38 and K99) or research award

eligibility.item: Candidates with a prior non-aging NIH individual award may apply but must justify a meaningful shift toward aging-related science
eligibility.quote: However, such individuals must provide strong justification in their application explaining how their proposed research will entail a meaningful shift towards aging-related science

eligibility.item: Candidate must have, or will have, a faculty appointment at the start of funding; appointments contingent on the award are not acceptable
eligibility.quote: Eligibility is limited to candidates who have, or will have, a faculty appointment at the start of GEMSSTAR funding.

eligibility.item: Candidates should typically be within 10 years of completing training and early in aging-related research
eligibility.quote: Candidates should typically be within 10 years of completing their training, although exceptions may be granted.

eligibility.item: Applications are expected to have a single PD/PI; other personnel are collaborators or consultants
eligibility.quote: It is expected that GEMSSTAR applications will have a single PD/PI and that other personnel will be listed as collaborators or consultants.

eligibility.item: Include at least one senior collaborator with complementary aging research experience
eligibility.quote: there should be at least one senior research collaborator with such complementary aging research experience as documented through aging-related publications, funding, and resources

eligibility.item: A concurrent mentored K application must not have aims overlapping the GEMSSTAR application
eligibility.quote: The aims of the two applications must not overlap per NIH submission policies.

eligibility.item: Only New and Resubmission application types are allowed
eligibility.quote: Application Types Allowed New Resubmission The OER Glossary and the How to Apply Application Guide provide details on these application types.

eligibility.item: Clinical trials are optional
eligibility.quote: Optional: Accepting applications that either propose or do not propose clinical trial(s).

eligibility.item: Non-participating ICOs (only NIA, NIDCR, NINR, NIMHD participate) will not consider applications
eligibility.quote: ICOs that do not participate in this announcement will not consider applications for funding.

eligibility.item: Organizations may submit more than one application only if each is scientifically distinct
eligibility.quote: Applicant organizations may submit more than one application, provided that each application is scientifically distinct.

eligibility.item: A new (A0) application is not accepted before the summary statement issues for an overlapping A0 or A1 application
eligibility.quote: A new (A0) application that is submitted before issuance of the summary statement from the review of an overlapping new (A0) or resubmission (A1) application.

eligibility.item: A resubmission (A1) is not accepted before the summary statement issues for the previous A0 application
eligibility.quote: A resubmission (A1) application that is submitted before issuance of the summary statement from the review of the previous new (A0) application.

eligibility.item: An application substantially overlapping another application pending appeal of initial peer review is not accepted
eligibility.quote: An application that has substantial overlap with another application pending appeal of initial peer review

requiredDocuments.quote: Applicants should use the biographical sketch of the principal investigator to illustrate how this award will advance the investigator's career in aging research.

requiredDocuments.item: Modular Budget (multiples of $25,000 up to $125,000 per year)
requiredDocuments.quote: Applicants should use the Modular Budget format. Annual direct costs can be requested in multiples of $25,000 up to $125,000.

requiredDocuments.item: Budget justification describing travel to the annual GEMSSTAR grantees meeting
requiredDocuments.quote: There is no specific line item in the Modular Budget format in which to list travel costs; instead, the proposed travel should be described in the budget justification section.
R&R Subaward Budget All instructions in the How to Apply - Application Guide must be followed.
PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement All instructions in the How to Apply - Application Guide must be followed.

requiredDocuments.item: Letters of Support from department/division chairs, institutional leaders, senior collaborators and PDP mentors
requiredDocuments.quote: Letters of support from department or division chairs, other institutional leaders, senior collaborators, and other contributors should describe, where appropriate, the following

requiredDocuments.item: For applicants in their last year of training: documentation of the institution's commitment to the faculty appointment
requiredDocuments.quote: For applicants in their last year of training, documentation of the institution's commitment to the applicant's faculty appointment, which should commence no later than the start of the GEMSSTAR R03 award

requiredDocuments.item: If PDP funding is known: official letter from the funding source stating amount, duration and stipulations, as an Other Attachment
requiredDocuments.quote: If PDP funding support is known at the time of application, an official letter from the institution, society, foundation, or other source should be provided

requiredDocuments.item: At least one human subjects study record (or Delayed Onset Study record) if human subjects are involved
requiredDocuments.quote: you must include at least one human subjects study record using the Study Record: PHS Human Subjects and Clinical Trials Information form or Delayed Onset Study record.
PHS Assignment Request Form All instructions in the How to Apply- Application Guide must be followed.
